name: TouchPulse

descriptions.en_US: Highly customizable, full-canvas modular information display for the Stream Deck + Touch Bar. Mix, match, and stack System Monitors (CPU, RAM, Disk, Network), Media Player with live audio visualizer, Live Weather, World Clock, Stacked Date & Time, and custom wallpapers across three independent sections.
